rb1_blockers.description: The frozen capabilities and current-canonical preservation evidence are reconciled, but F-RB01 has not yet executed its own exact-candidate release qualification suite.
rb1_blockers.closure_condition: One exact immutable RB1 source candidate must pass the F-RB01 release workflow and the resulting evidence must be persisted.

post_rb1.item: broader process migration and arbitrary process composition
parallel active DIVDRA and broader drainage variants
active WOFOST/crop runtime canonical release admission
representative accepted difficult-column p50/p95/p99 and bounded-cost production policy
universal or application-class direct SWAP-MODFLOW release claims
formal Status-A evidence package using F-DOC01 traceability architecture

performance_classification.reason: No externally justified absolute RB1 runtime threshold was found or pre-registered. F-RB01 therefore characterizes production viability and preserves negative evidence instead of fabricating an SLA.

parallel_v1_characterization.fixture: 32 logical columns, batch_size 9, frozen restricted V1 physical profile
parallel_v1_characterization.worker_2: reproducible positive scaling; median speedup range 1.6585 to 1.6802; 60/60 paired blocks >1
parallel_v1_characterization.worker_4: positive but not robust; median speedup range 1.2534 to 1.8095; 60/60 paired blocks >1; host/runtime sensitive tails retained as negative evidence

reference_tail_characterization.interpretation: Rejected difficult perturbations prove potentially high rejected-trial cost but do not justify an accepted production-tail distribution or bounded-cost threshold.

surface_evaporation_allocation.median_local_runtime_reduction_percent: approximately 31.9 to 35.2 across the admitted measurement nodes

memory_and_allocation.qualification_basis: architecture/source ownership rather than an invented absolute RSS limit
claims: heavy solver/runtime scratch is worker-owned rather than one heavyweight solver per logical column
surface-evaporation call-local copy/allocation debt was remediated by F-PE11 without reopening scientific authority
memory_and_allocation.nonclaim: No universal bytes-per-column or peak-RSS production SLA is established by F-RB01.

production_fix_policy: Any newly discovered production defect must leave F-RB01, be remediated and independently/canonically qualified in its owner line, then return through a fresh RB1 candidate. No ad-hoc production fixes are permitted on this release branch.
